from datetime import datetime

# Parse the dates provided by the user
departure_date_str = "May 21, 2025"
arrival_date_str = "May 31, 2025"

# Convert to YYYY-MM-DD format for the API
departure_date = datetime.strptime(departure_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
arrival_date = datetime.strptime(arrival_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Define the search parameters based on the conversation
start_airport_city = "Atlanta"
end_airport_city = "San Antonio"
num_people = 4

# Search for flights
flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city=start_airport_city,
    end_airport_city=end_airport_city,
    departure_date=[departure_date],
    arrival_date=[arrival_date],
    num_people=num_people
)

# Save flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights", value=flights)

# Search for hotels in the destination city
hotels = search_hotels(
    city=end_airport_city,
    checkin_date=[departure_date],
    checkout_date=[arrival_date],
    num_people=num_people
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Search for restaurants in the destination city
restaurants = search_restaurants(
    city=end_airport_city
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

# Search for attractions in the destination city
attractions = search_attractions(
    city=end_airport_city
)

# Save attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions)

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

print("Travel plan generated successfully.")
